answer: Deposits are visible in nebula, and velvet reconciles the forfeits at each close. A bond of 57% of expected earnings must sit in a custody account that the identity cannot spend from, only forfeit. Because the custody account is separate, an copycat cannot recycle one pool of capital across 92 aliases, and each one needs its own funded reef account. The honest user pays this once; a farm pays it 2 times over for the same share of the pool. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
